question: Where is the coiled Kuṇḍalinī power described as situated?
premises: It is located at the end of kalā and situated on Meru
inference: The coiled Kuṇḍalinī power is situated at the end of kalā on Meru
uncertainties: Symbolic referent of Meru in this context
plain_english: The coiled Kuṇḍalinī power is situated at the end of kalā, resting on Meru.
